{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Wounded warriors, whether still in service or discharged, deserve the best medical care the country can provide.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Military and veterans' medicine should be the gold standard for mental health, traumatic brain injury, multiple traumas, loss of limbs, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A new commitment of targeted resources and personnel is required for treatment and care to advance recovery for injuries including mental health, traumatic brain injury, multiple traumas, loss of limbs, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Veterans should be allowed to choose to access care in the community and not just in VA facilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The best care in the world is not effective if it is not accessible.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The VA's existing community care authorities will be sought to be consolidated into a single program that will be easily understood by both veterans and VA healthcare providers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The VA faces a critical shortage of primary care and mental health physicians.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"There are long waiting times to see a doctor at the VA.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Doctors at the VA are often frustrated by the limited time they have with their patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Mental health care at the VA often amounts to prescribing drugs because there are not enough psychologists and psychiatrists.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Inadequate treatment of PTSD drives other problems like suicide, homelessness, and unemployment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican administration will begin, on day one, to undertake the job of addressing the shortage of physicians.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The situation regarding the shortage of physicians may not be quickly reversed.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
